Once there was a crow. One hot summer day it became very thirsty. It flew here and there in search of water but found none. At last it saw a pitcher in a garden. It flew down and found a little water at the bottom of the pitcher. But the water was so low that the crow could not reach it.

The crow did not lose heart. It looked around and saw some pebbles nearby. An idea came to its mind. It began to drop the pebbles into the pitcher one by one. Slowly the water rose up. At last the water came within its reach. The crow drank the water happily and flew away.

Moral: Where there is a will, there is a way.

Unity is Strength

Once there lived an old farmer. He had four sons. But the sons always quarrelled with one another. The old man was very worried about them. He wanted to teach them a lesson.

One day he called his sons and gave them a bundle of sticks. He asked each of them to break the bundle. One by one they tried with all their strength, but none could break it. Then the old man untied the bundle and gave each son a single stick. This time they broke the sticks very easily.

The old man said, 'My sons, if you remain united like the bundle, no one can harm you. But if you quarrel, your enemies will break you easily.' The sons understood their mistake and promised to live in unity.

Moral: Unity is strength.

[Name of School]
[Place]

data.prompt_en: Write a paragraph comparing 'Village Life and Town Life' (comparison and contrast).
data.model_answer_en: Village life and town life are different in many ways. The main difference lies in the environment. A village is calm, quiet and full of natural beauty, whereas a town is noisy, crowded and full of smoke. In a village, the air is fresh and pure, but in a town it is often polluted. As regards facilities, town life offers more advantages. Towns have good schools, colleges, hospitals and markets, while villages often lack these facilities. On the other hand, the cost of living is low in a village but very high in a town. People in villages are simple and friendly and help one another, whereas town people are busy and have little time for their neighbours. However, both have their own charms. A village gives peace and a healthy life, while a town gives comfort and opportunities. To sum up, though town life is more comfortable, village life is more peaceful and healthy. A wise person enjoys the good sides of both.

data.prompt_en: Write a paragraph on 'Causes and Effects of Air Pollution' (cause and effect).
data.model_answer_en: Air pollution has become a serious problem in our country. There are several causes behind it. The main cause is the smoke emitted from mills, factories and vehicles. This smoke contains harmful gases that pollute the air. Moreover, the burning of fossil fuels, brick kilns and the reckless cutting of trees also pollute the air. These causes lead to many harmful effects. As a result of air pollution, people suffer from various diseases such as asthma, breathing problems and lung cancer. In addition, polluted air destroys the balance of nature and causes global warming. Because of global warming, the sea level is rising and the climate is changing. If we do not control air pollution now, our future will be in great danger. So, we should plant more trees, use eco-friendly vehicles and control the smoke of factories. Only then can we ensure fresh air and a healthy life.

data.prompt_en: Write a paragraph on 'Tree Plantation' by listing its importance.
data.model_answer_en: Tree plantation means planting trees in a planned way. Trees are very important for our life and environment. First, trees give us oxygen which we need to breathe. Second, they take in carbon dioxide and keep the air fresh and free from pollution. Third, trees give us fruits, wood, medicine and shade. They are also the home of many birds and animals. Moreover, trees prevent soil erosion and cause rainfall. They protect us from floods, storms and the greenhouse effect. Without trees, the earth would turn into a desert and life would be impossible. Sadly, people are cutting down trees carelessly. This is very harmful for us. So, we should plant more trees, especially during the rainy season, and take care of them. The best time for tree plantation is the month of Ashar and Sraban. Everyone should plant at least one tree. Thus, we can make our country greener, healthier and more beautiful.

data.prompt_en: Write a paragraph describing 'A Rainy Day'.
data.model_answer_en: A rainy day is a day of continuous rain. The sky remains cloudy and the sun is hardly seen. It may rain all day long, sometimes heavily and sometimes gently. On such a day, the roads become muddy and slippery. Poor people and day labourers suffer a lot because they cannot go out to work. Schools and offices wear an empty look as many people stay at home. However, a rainy day is not without joy. Children enjoy making paper boats and playing in the rain water. Village boys catch fish in the flooded fields. Many people like to eat khichuri and hilsha fish on a rainy day. Farmers become happy because rain is good for their crops. But too much rain causes flood and damages houses and crops. On the whole, a rainy day brings both happiness and suffering to our life.
